aphoristic: Aphorizein: define. An aphoristic style: Wilde-like one-liners.
Aphoristic: a speech made of quotable sentences.
candidness: Candidus: white, honest. Candidness in feedback.
Candidness: telling it as it is.
collusion: Col + ludere: play together. Collusion between rival firms.
Collusion: a secret deal to fix prices.
complacent: Complacere: please oneself. Complacent after the win.
Complacent: sleeping on the sofa as the house burns.
connive: Con + nivere: wink together. Connive in the fraud.
convoluted: Con + volvere: roll up. A convoluted plot.
destitute: Destituere: abandon. A destitute family on the street.
devolve: De + volvere: roll down. Power devolves to the regions.
discord: Dis + cor: hearts apart. Discord in the family.
eke: Eke: add to. Eke out a living.
elude: E + ludere: dodge. The answer eludes me.
embellish: Em + bel: beautify. Embellish the story.
enmity: Inimicus: enemy. Deep enmity between two clans.
exasperate: Ex + asper: rough. Exasperate the teacher.
foible: Foible: weak. A harmless foible, like being late.
goad: Goad: a prodding stick. Goad him into action.
impending: In + pendere: hang over. Impending storm.
impregnable: In + prendre: can’t be taken. An impregnable fortress.
irk: Irk: annoy. It irks me when you’re late.
leery: Leer: sidelong look. Leery of strangers.
malevolent: Mal + velle: wish ill. A malevolent glare.
maxim: Maxima: greatest rule. “Better late than never”.
pastoral: Pastor: shepherd. A pastoral scene with sheep.
perturb: Per + turbare: disturb. News that perturbed him.
ploy: Ploy: a trick. A ploy to win attention.
presumption: Praesumere: take beforehand. The presumption to speak for us.
Presumption: arrogance, or a working assumption.
quip: Quip: a witty line. A quick quip lightens the meeting.
reservation: Reserve: hold back. I have reservations.
retract: Re + trahere: draw back. Retract a statement.
Retract: take it back, like a cat’s claws.
steadfast: Stead + fast: fixed in place. Steadfast loyalty.
tact: Tact: knowing what not to say.
tarnish: Ternir: dull. Tarnish silver; tarnish a reputation.
tout: Tout: solicit. Touted as the next big thing.
travail: Travail: toil. The travail of childbirth.
